ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominant; approximately 95% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 5% high-intensity (white/beige) pixels concentrated at distal tips and sparse surface specks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across the entire ventral plane. High-contrast, irregular geometric clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right). Sparse, non-contiguous white punctate dots are scattered across the medial and lateral lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 90-100 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serration profile with irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 2-10 pixels in amplitude relative to the local edge baseline across the entire posterior margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the distal tips toward the median notch, with a convex anterior margin transition at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white/beige pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) at both distal tips. Multiple isolated circular white pixel groups (diameter 2-5 pixels) distributed across the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biological encrustations (barnacles) creating a highly irregular, high-relief texture at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical distal tip colonization patterns.
